preconditions.description: The integer n is between 1 and 300000 inclusive.
The permutation list contains exactly n integers.
The permutation contains each integer from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if there exists a pair (a, b) with a != b such that a/2 is between a and b in the permutation, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: exists_valid_pair == any((a != b) and (a % 2 == 0) and (is_between(permutation, a, b, a // 2)) for a in range(1, n + 1) for b in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: A valid pair exists if and only if there are distinct integers a and b in the permutation such that a is even and the value a/2 appears strictly between the positions of a and b.
